Title: PDF Compressor
Description: Compress PDF files to reduce their size directly in your browser with no uploads required.
DropZoneTitle: Drag and drop PDF files here
Seo_Introduction: The PDF Compressor is a privacy-first online tool designed for developers and everyday users. All processing happens locally in your browser using WebAssembly, ensuring your PDFs never leave your device.
Seo_DetailedDescription:
This tool provides fast and efficient compression of PDF files directly in your browser. Built with modern web technologies and powered by Rust-compiled WebAssembly, it reduces file size without requiring any server uploads.

The interface is designed for simplicity and efficiency. You can upload one or multiple PDF files, compress them in a single click, and download the results immediately. All operations are performed client-side, guaranteeing complete privacy for your sensitive documents.
Seo_Examples:
**Example 1**: Compress a large PDF report before emailing it to reduce attachment size.

**Example 2**: Reduce the size of scanned PDF documents for easier storage and sharing.

**Example 3**: Batch-compress multiple PDF files at once to save storage space.
Seo_HowToSteps:
### Step 1: Upload PDF Files
Click the upload button or drag and drop one or more PDF files into the tool.

### Step 2: Compress
Click the "Compress PDFs" button to process your files locally in the browser.

### Step 3: Download
Download each compressed file individually once processing is complete.
Seo_Tips:
- All processing happens in your browser for maximum privacy
- The tool works offline after initial page load
- Your files are never uploaded to any server
- Supports multiple PDF files in a single session
